sections.heading: What is bovine colostrum powder
paragraphs: Bovine colostrum is the first milk a cow produces after calving. It is collected and dried into a fine powder. Colostrum is valued as an ingredient for its immunoglobulin G (IgG) content, alongside naturally occurring lactoferrin and growth factors.
Buyers specify colostrum by its IgG percentage, which is why we supply it in standardized grades. A higher grade delivers the same IgG in a smaller serving.
